"""Field, grammar and selector specifications for the finite offline pipeline.

The finite telemetry contract needs no schema validation of external files, so
these specifications are plain dataclasses/enums: the same names and shapes the
original core used, without the runtime validation dependency.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Literal


class SourceType(str, Enum):
    AUTO = "auto"
    CSV = "csv"
    FINITE = "finite"


class ValueType(str, Enum):
    INTEGER = "integer"
    REAL = "real"
    CATEGORICAL = "categorical"
    BOOLEAN = "boolean"
    STRING = "string"


class FieldRole(str, Enum):
    SRC = "src"
    DST = "dst"
    PROTO = "proto"
    TIME = "time"
    SEQUENCE = "sequence"
    MEASUREMENT = "measurement"
    IDENTIFIER = "identifier"
    WINDOW = "window"
    COUNT = "count"
    SIZE = "size"
    FLAG = "flag"
    DERIVED = "derived"


#: Protocol field types mapped onto the internal roles used by the finite core.
ROLE_BY_TYPE = {
    "time": FieldRole.TIME,
    "size": FieldRole.SIZE,
    "count": FieldRole.COUNT,
    "id": FieldRole.IDENTIFIER,
    "flag": FieldRole.FLAG,
}

#: Numeric protocol field types; the remaining types only permit eq/ne.
NUMERIC_TYPES = frozenset({"time", "size", "count"})


class Comparator(str, Enum):
    EQ = "="
    NE = "!="
    GT = ">"
    GE = ">="
    LT = "<"
    LE = "<="


#: Protocol operator spellings mapped onto internal comparators.
COMPARATOR_BY_OP = {
    "eq": Comparator.EQ,
    "ne": Comparator.NE,
    "lt": Comparator.LT,
    "le": Comparator.LE,
    "gt": Comparator.GT,
    "ge": Comparator.GE,
}


class ConstantKind(str, Enum):
    ASSIGNMENT = "assignment"
    SCALAR = "scalar"
    LIMIT = "limit"
    ADDITION = "addition"


class Aggregator(str, Enum):
    MIN = "min"
    MAX = "max"
    SUM = "sum"
    AVG = "avg"
    COUNT_NONZERO = "count_nonzero"
    EXISTS = "exists"
    FORALL = "forall"


class LearnerKind(str, Enum):
    EXACT = "exact"
    HITTING_SET = "hitting-set"
    TREE = "tree"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class FieldSpec:
    name: str
    source_name: str | None = None
    value_type: ValueType | None = None
    roles: list[FieldRole] = field(default_factory=list)
    domain: list[Any] | None = None
    context_family: str | None = None
    context_index: int | None = None
    description: str = ""


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DatasetSpec:
    name: str
    description: str = ""
    source_type: SourceType = SourceType.FINITE
    fields: list[FieldSpec] = field(default_factory=list)
    slots: int = 1


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ConstantSelectorSpec:
    mode: Literal["explicit", "domain", "profile", "field_constants"] = "profile"
    values: list[Any] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class VariableSelectorSpec:
    names: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    types: list[ValueType] = field(default_factory=list)
    roles: list[FieldRole] = field(default_factory=list)
    exclude: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class QuantifierTemplateSpec:
    name: str
    quantifier: Literal["forall", "exists"]
    selector: VariableSelectorSpec = field(default_factory=VariableSelectorSpec)
    operators: list[Comparator] = field(default_factory=list)
    constant: ConstantSelectorSpec = field(default_factory=ConstantSelectorSpec)
    description: str = ""


@dataclass(slots=True)
class GrammarSpec:
    name: str = "finite-disjunctions"
    description: str = ""
    max_clause_size: int = 4
    predicate_count: int = 0
PYEOF
cat > netnomos/dataset.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Prepared window frames: named integer columns over a fixed row set.

The finite contract evaluates every predicate over the declared universe (and,
through universe indices, over the training records), so a frame is just the
per-cell value columns plus the slot families used by quantified projection.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

import numpy as np


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PreparedDataset:
    name: str
    columns: tuple[str, ...]
    data: dict[str, np.ndarray]
    context_families: dict[str, list[str]]
    domains: dict[str, list[Any]]
    length: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def column(self, name: str) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.data[name]

    def family(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
        return self.context_families[name]


def cell_name(cell: int) -> str:
    return f"cell_{cell}"


def frame_from_universe(universe: Any, name: str = "finite-windows") -> PreparedDataset:
    """Build the universe frame: one int64 column per flattened window cell."""
    columns = tuple(cell_name(cell) for cell in range(universe.cell_count))
    data = {cell_name(cell): universe.values[cell] for cell in range(universe.cell_count)}
    families = {
        field_name: [cell_name(slot * universe.field_count + index) for slot in range(universe.slots)]
        for index, field_name in enumerate(universe.field_names)
    }
    domains = {
        cell_name(cell): universe.domain_of_cell(cell) for cell in range(universe.cell_count)
    }
    return PreparedDataset(
        name=name,
        columns=columns,
        data=data,
        context_families=families,
        domains=domains,
        length=int(universe.size),
        metadata={"source": "declared-domains", "cells": universe.cell_count},
    )
PYEOF
